title: Largest Plus Sign
prompt:
An `n × n` grid initially contains ones. Each coordinate in `mines` is a zero. Return the largest order of an axis-aligned plus sign made entirely of ones, or 0 if none exists. An order-`k` plus consists of its center and four arms of length `k - 1`, extending up, down, left, and right. A lone one has order 1.

Assume `n >= 1` and unique, in-bounds mine coordinates.

example.reasoning: A plus with one cell in each arm fits, while no order-three plus survives.
